summary.text: Alisson Turcotte is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former state representative who worked for the New Hampshire Department of Transportation, she served from 2012 to 2020 and from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Alisson Turcotte's career experience includes working for the New Hampshire Department of Transportation.

She was first elected to the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2012, representing Merrimack 22, where she served on the Environment and Agriculture Committee in the 2013 to 2017 sessions and on the Legislative Administration Committee in 2019-2020.
She was re-elected in 2018, defeating Scott McDonald.
Turcotte won Merrimack 11 on November 8, 2022, defeating incumbent Matthew Pitaro, and served on the Legislative Administration Committee in 2023-2024.
Pitaro defeated her in the November 5, 2024 general election, and she left office on December 4, 2024; the two face each other again in the November 2026 general election.
